title: 📋 Server Rules & Guidelines
description:
Welcome to CIPHER! Please read and follow these rules carefully to maintain a safe and respectful community. Violation of these rules may result in warnings, mutes, kicks, or permanent bans.

**By staying in this server, you agree to comply with all rules listed below.**

fields.name: 🤝 Rule 1: Be Respectful
fields.value:
• Treat all members with respect and kindness
• No harassment, bullying, or personal attacks
• Respect different opinions and perspectives
• Keep conversations civil and constructive

fields.name: 🚫 Rule 2: No Hate Speech or Discrimination
fields.value:
• No racism, sexism, homophobia, or any form of discrimination
• No slurs or offensive language targeting any group
• No hate symbols or imagery
• This includes jokes or "ironic" content

fields.name: 💬 Rule 3: No Spam or Flooding
fields.value:
• Do not spam messages, emojis, or reactions
• No excessive caps lock or repeated characters
• No mass mentions or ghost pings
• Keep messages relevant to the channel topic

fields.name: 🔞 Rule 4: Keep Content Appropriate
fields.value:
• No NSFW content (images, links, or discussions)
• No gore, violence, or disturbing content
• No sexual or suggestive content
• Keep profile pictures and usernames appropriate

fields.name: 🔒 Rule 5: Protect Privacy
fields.value:
• Do not share personal information (yours or others)
• No doxxing or threats of any kind
• Respect others' privacy and boundaries
• Do not share private conversations publicly

fields.name: 📢 Rule 6: No Advertising or Self-Promotion
fields.value:
• No advertising other Discord servers without permission
• No self-promotion or unsolicited DM advertising
• No referral links or affiliate spam
• Ask staff before sharing external content

fields.name: 🎯 Rule 7: Use Channels Correctly
fields.value:
• Read channel descriptions and use them appropriately
• Keep discussions on-topic for each channel
• Use voice channels respectfully (no mic spam)
• Follow any specific channel rules posted

fields.name: 👮 Rule 8: Respect Staff & Moderators
fields.value:
• Follow staff instructions and decisions
• Do not argue with staff in public channels
• Do not ping staff unnecessarily
• Use tickets or DMs for private matters

fields.name: ⚠️ Rule 9: No Illegal Content or Activities
fields.value:
• Do not share or discuss illegal activities
• No piracy, hacking tutorials, or illegal downloads
• No discussion of drugs or illegal substances
• Follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines

fields.name: 🛡️ Rule 10: Report Issues
fields.value:
• Report rule violations to staff immediately
• Do not take matters into your own hands
• Use the ticket system for serious issues
• Help us keep the community safe and welcoming
